title: Learning High-Speed Flight in the Wild
abstract: End-to-end RL policy mapping depth images to body-rate and thrust commands for agile quadrotor flight through natural forest at up to 10 m/s. Uses 4-frame depth stack, trained with PPO purely in simulation with domain randomization, zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

title: Deep Drone Racing: From Simulation to Reality with Domain Randomization
abstract: CNN policy from stacked 4-frame depth images for autonomous drone racing. Imitation learning from expert MPC policy, then RL fine-tuning. Extensive domain randomization on depth rendering parameters enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

title: Champion-level Drone Racing using Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Vision-based end-to-end RL system defeating human world champions in physical drone racing. Combines learned visual encoder, memory module, and control module. Trained in simulation with domain randomization.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Collision-free Flight Exploiting Deep Collision Encoding
abstract: Deep Collision Encoder (DCE) compressing depth images into collision-aware latent via self-supervised auxiliary collision prediction. Encoder pretrained and frozen, latent fed to RL policy. Built on the Aerial Gym Simulator.

title: Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion over Challenging Terrain
abstract: Teacher-student framework: teacher trained with privileged terrain information, student learns from depth and proprioception. Student runs onboard in real-time. Zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

title: Learning by Cheating
abstract: Privileged agent (full state and map) trained first; vision-based sensor agent distilled via online DAgger-style imitation. Formulates privileged-to-sensor transition as 'learning by cheating'.

title: Asymmetric Actor Critic for Image-Based Robot Learning
abstract: Asymmetric actor-critic architecture where actor receives only images (no privileged state) but critic receives full privileged state during training. Critic provides better gradients without privileged info at deployment.

title: RMA: Rapid Motor Adaptation for Legged Robots
abstract: Two-stage framework: teacher trained with privileged environment info, student adaptation module infers privileged latent from proprioception history. No depth/vision, uses proprioception and action history.

title: DroNet: Learning to Fly by Driving
abstract: Imitation learning from car driving data for drone collision avoidance. Uses single RGB camera. Demonstrates cross-domain transfer from cars to drones.

title: Reinforcement Learning with Unsupervised Auxiliary Tasks
abstract: UNREAL agent learns auxiliary control and reward prediction tasks alongside main RL objective. Auxiliary tasks shape shared representation, improving data efficiency and final performance.

title: Learning to be Safe: Deep RL with a Safety Critic
abstract: Learns a binary safety critic predicting probability of entering dangerous states, trained from offline trajectories. The safety critic constrains exploration during online RL on new tasks. Tested on navigation, locomotion, and manipulation.

title: Failure-Aware RL: Reliable Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning with Self-Recovery for Real-World Manipulation
abstract: World-model-based safety critic trained offline to predict Intervention-requiring Failures. During online RL, safety critic detects impending failures and triggers recovery. 73.1% reduction in IR failures on real robots.

title: Recovery RL: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Learned Recovery Zones
abstract: Learns to predict unsafe states (recovery zones) from offline data, then uses separate recovery policy when agent enters predicted unsafe regions. Binary safety classifier trained offline, integrated into online RL via policy switching.

title: Learning Vision-based Pursuit-Evasion Robot Policies
abstract: Transforms pursuit-evasion into teacher-student problem: fully-observable privileged teacher generates supervision for partially-observable vision-based student. Student learns to gather information when uncertain and anticipate to intercept. Deployed on physical quadruped with RGB-D.

title: Control Strategies for Pursuit-Evasion Under Occlusion Using Visibility and Safety Barrier Functions
abstract: Visibility-based CBFs to keep evader within pursuer's FoV despite occlusions. Signed distance functions of FoV as CBF constraints. Sampling-based kinodynamic planner for non-myopic pursuit under occlusion.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Collision Avoidance
abstract: Uses MC dropout to estimate predictive uncertainty of dynamics model, then uses uncertainty as collision risk signal for action selection. Uncertainty to risk proxy to control pipeline.

title: Estimating Risk and Uncertainty in Deep Reinforcement Learning
venue: ICML Workshop on Uncertainty and Robustness in Deep Learning
abstract: Framework for disentangling epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty in learned Q-values. Derives unbiased uncertainty estimators. Proposes uncertainty-aware DQN algorithm with safe learning behavior.

title: A Multiplicative Value Function for Safe and Efficient Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Factorizes value function into safety critic (constraint violation probability) and reward critic (constraint-free returns). Multiplicative decomposition allows policy to trade off risk against reward. Zero-shot sim-to-real.

title: Accelerating Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Datasets
abstract: Uses offline data to pretrain policies via advantage-weighted regression (AWAC), then fine-tunes online. Shows dramatic sample efficiency gains from offline pretraining.

title: CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Contrastive learning (SimCLR-style) for visual RL representations. Learns image representations via instance discrimination before/alongside RL training.

title: Pretraining Representations for Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Self-supervised pretraining of visual representations for RL using temporal contrastive learning (SPR). Frozen or fine-tuned pretrained encoder dramatically improves sample efficiency in online RL.

title: Safe Exploration in Continuous Action Spaces
abstract: Safety layer that analytically solves a QP to minimally perturb RL policy action to satisfy safety constraints. Safety layer is a differentiable projection: argmin ||u - u_rl||^2 s.t. C(u) <= 0.

title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Shielding
abstract: Shield that monitors RL agent's action and overrides it when it would violate temporal logic safety specification. Shield is pre-computed from safety specs. Least-restrictive shield concept.

title: Learning for Safety-Critical Control with Control Barrier Functions
abstract: Learning-based framework for CBFs: learns system model and uses it to construct CBF safety filters. Combines model learning with barrier-certified safety.

title: End-to-End Safe Reinforcement Learning through Barrier Functions for Safety-Critical Continuous Control Tasks
abstract: Integrates CBFs directly into RL: CBF-based safety controller intervenes during exploration and policy updates. Combines model-free RL with model-based CBFs for guaranteed safety during training.

title: Constrained Policy Optimization
abstract: CPO: constrained policy optimization with trust-region guarantees. First principled algorithm for policy gradient under safety constraints (cost limits). max J(pi) s.t. D(pi) <= d.

title: Benchmarking Safe Exploration in Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Standardized benchmark suite (Safety Gym) for safe RL. Formalizes cost-constrained MDPs with collision avoidance and goal-reaching. Introduces CPO, PPO-Lagrangian, TRPO-Lagrangian baselines.
